selection: Purposive exploratory selection. All source texts inspected before parser design. No held-out generalization claim.
tfidf: Document-local char 2–4 grams; sublinear tf; L2; no label fitting.

model.training: none; masked language pretraining only; no retrieval fine-tuning

extraction.pdf: PyMuPDF sorted geometric text; no OCR/manual correction
extraction.offsets: 0-based Unicode code points in page/section canonical text; end exclusive

metrics: Value exact agreement and value+reference-evidence joint agreement on 30 answerable slots; wrong and abstain separate; 2 not-established slots separately. Recall of ALL required evidence groups for retrieval. Descriptive only; eight docs from one municipality.
freeze: Code, protocol and reference hashes recorded before first inference; exploratory, not preregistration.
scope: Selected conditions only. Income input represents a pre-established administrative percent category, not salary/insurance conversion. No actual applicants. No true erratum pairs; no causal policy effect estimate.
